slop.quote: Sparkle also expects updates to keep the same bundle ID, so existing installs likely couldn't auto-update to the renamed app.
To get the OpenRamble name without the cost, change only the display name (`CFBundleDisplayName` / product name) and keep the bundle ID.
If you still want the new identifier, you'd first need to change the invariant in the rules file.
